@img/sharp-libvips-*.reason: Next's image optimiser loads libvips as its own prebuilt shared library, unmodified; the notice and licence text ship in the web image.

web-push.reason: File-level copyleft; used unmodified from npm, so only its notice is owed.

caniuse-lite.reason: Browser-support data that browserslist reads; attribution only, given in the notices.

com.goterl:lazysodium-android.reason: File-level copyleft; used unmodified from Maven, so only its notice is owed.

net.java.dev.jna:jna.reason: Dual-licensed LGPL-2.1 or Apache-2.0 (the POM lists both); used unmodified as its own AAR, under the Apache-2.0 option.

com.google.android.gms:play-services-cod.reason: Google's scanner runs in Play services; it is under ML Kit's terms of service, not an open licence.

com.google.android.gms:*.reason: Google Play services client libraries (sign-in, credentials, FCM): Google's Android SDK terms, not an open licence.

com.google.android.libraries.identity.go.reason: Google's Credential Manager helper, under the Android SDK terms.

com.google.android.odml:*.reason: A Google ML image type that ML Kit's scanner needs, under the Android SDK terms.

com.google.firebase:*.reason: Firebase Cloud Messaging's client, for push; under the Android SDK terms.

com.google.mlkit:*.reason: ML Kit's barcode scanning core, under ML Kit's terms of service.
